entries.description: Rugged wheeled synthetic conveyance. Drives itself, obeys simple instructions. Difficult to steal — will not accept a new master until the old has died.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.73 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Mechanical effigy of a warrior-saint. Pilot suspended foetus-like in cushioning gels inside the belly. Rare; maintained by secretive monastic orders.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.73 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Crude desert vehicle running on guzzeline. Roll-cage bolted to a smoky engine driving four wheels. Fast, rough, loud.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.74 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Heliotrope mantle decorated with Rappash-Ik's personal seal. Spun for the Autarch's shadows. Less valuable than Rappash-Ik's true mantle, but few observers would know the difference.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.287 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Polychrome halo that projects a dazzling nimbus of light around the wearer's head. Forged for the Autarch's shadows. Less valuable than Rappash-Ik's true Peacock Crown, but few would know the difference.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.287 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

vehicle_stats.crew: Normally used as pack animals but can be ridden in extremis.

entries.description: Boxy, crude four-legged automaton. Extremely enduring and hardy but clumsy, stupid, and nauseating to ride.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.74 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

vehicle_stats.crew: No pilot needed. Can house up to 20 comfortably.

entries.description: Self-aware motile dwelling. Half crab, half house, fully sentient. Extremely durable, slow, cramped.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.74 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Pre-Collapse flying machine beating artificial wings. Smaller models are hummingbird-like (single seat); Hegemony transports resemble dragonflies.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.75 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Purple plastic rectangle emblazoned with Rappash-Ik's personal seal. Highest-level access to Fallen Autarchy military facilities. Only functions inside the Fount of Illustrious Flesh, but valuable to Exotica collectors.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.287 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Scarlet plastic rectangle emblazoned with Rappash-Ik's military seal. Standard-level access to Fallen Autarchy military facilities. Only functions inside the Fount of Illustrious Flesh, but valuable to Exotica collectors.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.287 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Lightweight hover-bike built around a small sky-seeking stone, powered by a rear fan. Fast, nimble, frequently lethal when malfunctioning.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.75 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Ponderous towering mechanised walker. Hardy, navigates treacherous ground. Hegemony uses for assaults on fortified positions.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.75 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Healing dose carried by Priests of the Promised Sun. Heals d8 HP.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.251 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

vehicle_stats.crew: Needs no pilot. Up to 4 passengers

entries.description: Trundling reinforced plastiglass orb. Climate-controlled seats, beverage fabricators. Fabricates 1 ration of fizzy drink per day. Talks and lectures on local flora and fauna (read PCs the relevant bestiary entry).
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.76 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

vehicle_stats.crew: 1 sits the throne, 12 retainers may cling to the sides
special: Damage Immunity: impervious to all damage; pilot immortal while seated (can be wrestled from throne). Only anti-paradox weapons unravel its construction, reverting it to inert crystal throne.

entries.description: Hovering throne of manifold crystal. Each was carved for a specific God-king. Flies like a comet at sitter's command. Wars have been fought over the right to sit atop one.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.76 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

entries.description: Ancient chassis-mounted field that renders most kinetic attacks harmless. Disrupted by EMP (reduces wearer to natural AV).
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.250 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)

vehicle_stats.crew: At least 4 crew to operate, can carry 50 passengers
special: Unarmed by ancient custom. Crew typically includes 2d6 Level 2 guards.

entries.description: Wooden cargo ship built around a large sky-seeking stone. Used by Vaarnish merchant guilds. Ornate or utilitarian, never armed — guards travel onboard.
entries.source: Crimson Hound printed p.76 (verified 2026-06-07 audit remediation)
